designDecisions: A FAMILY, NOT A MODE FLAG (R-disrupt / metasystematicity; SP-CENTERS D2-MF6 precedent one level up). Two constructors sharing a vocabulary, a profile library, and a discipline: makeCellDisruption (space-filling warped-Voronoi partition, BFS-from-walls interiorness — the shellRelief STEP-2 shape) + makeFociDisruption (sparse pool-∝-N field-biased rejection sampling, per-feature heavy-tailed radii, typed analytic profiles — the stagnantLid corona shape). The duals stay distinct BY DESIGN: placement algorithms, count semantics (fixed band vs emergent-from-pool), radial coordinates (wall-referenced BFS inward vs center-referenced analytic ρ outward), and deformation semantics (gate-for-consumer-texture vs additive typed contribution) are NEVER unified under a shared parameter.

THE PROFILE LIBRARY IS THE ONE LEGITIMATE 1:1 EXTRACTION. The dome/trench/rise + rim/depression formulas are already copy-duplicated verbatim between stagnantLid.js STEP-3 and mixedInterior.js STEP-7 (grounding §1c finding — a third partial implementation with a third placement scheme). Extract them as pure ρ→Δh functions provably formula-identical to BOTH shipped inline copies (AC-PROFILE-EQ). The shipped files are NOT edited — the dedup of mixedInterior's copy is a recorded non-goal / post-V2-7 candidate.

NAMESPACE = 'disrupt:' with documented FROZEN draw orders. Cells: 1 count draw then 4/cell (randDir 2 + 2 RESERVED vigor/polarity draws kept deliberately — mirrors shell SLICE-B intent, prevents a future draw-order break; R6). Foci: per candidate randDir(2)+accept(1), on accept +radius(1)+type(1) — the stagnantLid conditional-draw-count pattern. The module never draws in any shipped namespace (grep-enforced) and therefore never byte-matches shipped worlds — by design; validation is structure-reproduction on synthetic inputs with ENUMERATED statistics (gate-3 discipline), never byte-match.

STRESS COUPLING STAYS CONSUMER-SIDE (R3). shellRelief's chaos gating by stressTensile is that writer's physics, not the disruption construction's. The module returns raw fields (interiorness, contrib, coverMask); callers gate/modulate. Lid-strength/field coupling enters ONLY via caller-supplied inputs: acceptWeightAt(dir)→[0,1] for placement bias (null ⇒ constant-accept control, the stagnant AC4 decoupling pattern) and amplitude scaling on the profile params.

PLACEMENT/EVAL SPLIT IS THE V2-7 EDITOR SEAM. evalFociDeformation(carrier, foci, profiles, P) is separate from makeFociDisruption so an epoch editor can mutate descriptors (deactivate a focus, change a type) and re-evaluate WITHOUT redrawing — demonstrated in AC-CONSUMER-SEAM. The module NEVER writes carrier channels and contains NO relax passes (SP-RELAX belongs to writers/composers); composition into datumStack is V2-7's job.

THE GROOVED PROFILE IS A CAPABILITY PROOF, NOT THE #4.5 DECISION (OQ-MAX-1, pending Max's confirm at greenlight). profileGroovedDiapir demonstrates profile pluggability on synthetic inputs only — no preset, no writer, no lab surface, no Miranda look. §7a keeps the block-jumble-vs-diapir pick Max's, at V2-9a scoping. If Max prefers, it drops to a test-local stub with the pluggability AC kept.

ZERO PRODUCTION WIRING (R1 mitigation; interpenetration.js precedent). No src/ file imports lidDisruption.js this increment; the increment's whole diff = the new module + new tests. Interface revision at V2-7 scoping is therefore cheap and non-breaking — the honest answer to the speculative-generality risk. Resist speculative knobs beyond what the two seeds + two consumer seams need.

GUARDRAILS UNCHANGED: three-free module (imports only alea / simplex-noise createNoise3D / mathutil), no Math.random/Date.now, bounded iteration only (the O(N) BFS queue drain — the plates/shell pattern), pool ∝ N + sizes × meanEdgeAngle resolution-invariance idioms, tune ? {...DEFAULTS,...tune} : DEFAULTS seam mirroring every sibling writer; stage only files we touch (not-ours CameraChoreographer.js/LabMode.js + untracked pile stay out of every commit).
